{
  "Select": [
    "molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id",
    "molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS name",
    "compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS structure",
    "drug_indication.efo_term AS indication_efo_term",
    "drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_mesh_heading"
  ],
  "Source": [
    "molecule_dictionary",
    "compound_structures",
    "drug_indication"
  ],
  "Join": [
    "molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno"
  ],
  "Filter": [
    "molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1",
    "AND (LOWER(drug_indication.efo_term) LIKE '%lymphoma%' OR LOWER(drug_indication.mesh_heading) LIKE '%lymphoma%')"
  ],
  "Sort": [
    "chembl_id ASC"
  ],
  "Limit": null
}
